name: tris-uoft
js: (async () => { const a = window.__CITY_APP; let best = { triangles: 0 }; for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) { await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(r)); const i = a.renderer.info; if ((i.render && i.render.triangles || 0) >= best.triangles) best = { triangles: i.render.triangles, calls: i.render.drawCalls }; } let fences = null; a.scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.name === "SchoolFences") fences = o; }); let posts = 0, panels = 0; if (fences) fences.traverse((o) => { if (o.name === "SchoolFencePosts") posts += o.count; if (o.name === "SchoolFencePanels") panels += o.count; }); return { ...best, rafSamples: 12, fencePosts: posts, fencePanels: panels, fenceStats: window.CITY.schoolFencesStats || null }; })()
